citation: Hamasaki A, Harada N, Muraoka A, et al. The integrated incretin effect is reduced by both glucose intolerance and obesity in Japanese subjects. Frontiers in Endocrinology. 2024.
protocol: 75 g OGTT (180 min) and isoglycaemic IV glucose infusion (20% w/v) on separate days after overnight fast
population: NGT n=14 (3 F, age 31.9+/-7.4, BMI 23.8+/-3.8); IGT n=6 (age 45.7); T2D n=8 (age 62.1); Japanese
note: Tables hold AUCs and fasting values; per-time curves are in figures. Gives the oral vs IV (incretin) contrast in a healthy (NGT) group and in IGT/T2D.
